creator: Alexander Terp
description: Split from a_2hIfvJdL0 (whose bug is fixed in b481606c). `muster tab move` only hands a tab to another window; nothing moves a tab within one. An agent asked to 'move tab X to just below tab Y' can read each tab's `place` in `muster window --json` but cannot change it. Something like `muster tab move --tab T --place 2` or `--after <tab>`, documented next to `place`, would cover it. a_2j175lvtj (drag a tab in the sidebar to reorder) and a_2JtSWvZUQ (where a new tab goes) want the same ordering verb.
title: muster tab move cannot change a tab's place within its window
